svg.title: The 10,000 Hour Tracker build timeline
svg.desc: Five stages take the Tracker from validation to real use: validating timer rules, building the Chinese interface, adding bilingual support and Owner access, deploying production, and refining the experience under real network conditions.
svg.text: PRODUCT BUILD TIMELINE
From core flow to real use
01 · VALIDATE THE RULES
Make the timer logic reliable
Test state transitions, one active timer,
and public filtering in Worker + local D1.
02 · BUILD THE INTERFACE
Start with the Chinese page
Connect the flow to Hugo; validate hierarchy,
mobile interactions, and Owner tools.
03 · EXTEND THE STRUCTURE
Share data, separate access
Chinese and English reuse the same template,
Worker, and D1. Visitors read public data;
authorized devices time and manage entries.
04 · DEPLOY PRODUCTION
Data service before page
Start with an empty D1. Deploy the Worker,
verify the API and access boundaries, then
publish the Tracker through GitHub Pages.
05 · REFINE IN REAL USE
Design for real networks
Remove sample values and show loading states.
Give Pause and Resume immediate feedback;
update from the action response on success,
and resync with D1 only after failure.
Live product; real use keeps shaping the design
